title: SpellForgeCostsPack
description: Mana crystal cost to create a spell at the rune forge. Default by rarity; optional per-spell overrides. Stronger spells gated by higher cost.

defaultByRarity.description: Mana crystals required to forge a spell of this rarity if no override.

overrides.description: Per-spellId mana crystal cost. Overrides defaultByRarity[spell.rarityId].
